episodes.title: Beware My Power (Part One)
episodes.summary: Two Green Lanterns, Hal Jordan and Kilowog, make an unsanctioned mission to the borders of the universe to investigate a Green Lantern's death.

episodes.title: Beware My Power (Part Two)
episodes.summary: Jordan and Kilowog make a rest stop at the home world of fellow Green Lantern Shyir Rev. But the Red Lanterns return, and a battle erupts.

episodes.title: Razer's Edge
episodes.summary: Jordan and Kilowog drop Razer at a nearby prison. But when they learn of torture going on at the prison, they go back for a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Into the Abyss
episodes.summary: With Razer's help, Hal and Kilowog are called upon to rescue a valuable cargo ship caught in a dangerous black hole-type anomaly before they're crushed alive.

episodes.title: Heir Apparent
episodes.summary: The Green Lanterns travel to Betrassus, a high tech yet medieval world, where they become embroiled in a murder investigation that could bring down Queen Iolande's kingdom before it even begins.

episodes.title: Lost Planet
episodes.summary: The Green Lanterns travel to a mysterious planet to save the inhabitants from an approaching asteroid on a lethal collision course…but the planet will not let them leave.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.summary: Razer goes to the Red Lantern homeworld Shard in an attempt to do what the Green Lanterns can't - kill Atrocitus.

episodes.title: Fear Itself
episodes.summary: With supplies running low, Hal and Kilowog search an uncharted planet for food and find themselves each stranded on different sides of the two warring species that live here.

episodes.title: ...In Love and War
episodes.summary: Carol Ferris encounters an alien jewel and becomes the Star Sapphire, a powerful but unstable Violet Lantern. She learns Hal Jordan's identity and fights him for his deceiving her.

episodes.title: Regime Change
episodes.summary: Returning to the planet Betrassus, Hal and his team try to help Queen Iolande against a new Red Lantern--her brother Prince Ragnor.

episodes.title: Flight Club
episodes.summary: The Green Lanters travel to a prison asteroid to learn the key to crossing "The Maelstrom," an impenetrable asteroid barrier before Atrocitus learns it first.

episodes.title: Invasion
episodes.summary: Hal and the Green Lanterns try to seal off a path through The Maelstrom before the Red Lantern armada makes it through…but Atrocitus has set a trap.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: While Atrocitus wreaks vengeance on Oa and the Guardians, Hal must teleport across the universe via the Star Sapphire's homeworld to stop him.

episodes.title: The New Guy
episodes.summary: Hal Jordan discovers that during his time in space, Earth got a replacement Green Lantern, the hard-edged challenging Guy Gardner.

episodes.title: Reboot
episodes.summary: Hal is ordered to reunite the crew of the "Interceptor" in order to investigate the Manhunter threat, but getting the band back together is not as easy as it sounds.

episodes.title: Steam Lantern
episodes.summary: Hal Jordan is knocked into a parallel zone containing a steampunk Earth, where he teams up with its Lantern Gil Broome to save it from a cataclysm.

episodes.title: Blue Hope
episodes.summary: Hal, Kilowog, and Aya visit the Blue Lantern planet Odym to seek help in their battle against the Manhunters. Unfortunately, thepower-boosting effect of the Blue Lanterns has an unexpected (and unwanted) side effect on their enemies…the Manhunters.

episodes.title: Prisoner of Sinestro
episodes.summary: Hal Jordan loves having Sinestro around because, at heart, the senior Lantern is a rule-bender, when the situation calls for it –something Hal entirely understands. But when Sinestro starts behaving erratically, Hal has no choice but to lock him up.

episodes.title: Loss
episodes.summary: Hal, Kilowog, Razer, and Aya attend a rebuilding ceremony between the Guardians and the Red Lanterns on their capitol planet,Ysmault. However, a rampant malfunctioning Manhunter threatens to derail the fragile state of peace between both sides. Meanwhile, the Anti-Monitor and his army of Manhunters pass through the Maelstrom and Hal and his teammates must slow them down ... at a terrible price.

episodes.title: Cold Fury
episodes.summary: A horde of Manhunters gives chase as our heroes' hope runs thin. Their will is truly tested as they prepare for an inevitable face-off against the unstoppable Anti-Monitor - a battle for the lives of everyone in the galaxy.

episodes.title: Babel
episodes.summary: Hal, Kilowog, and Razer crash land on a planet with a poisonous atmosphere. With their power rings nearly depleted, their only hope is to seek refuge in a nearby domed city, completely overrun by thieves and hooligans. But teamwork's a little tougher when no one can understand anyone else!

episodes.title: Love Is a Battlefield
episodes.summary: The evil Aya Monitor invades the planet Zamaron, blaming the Star Sapphires for the pain she feels from her heartbreak. The unsuspecting Carol Ferris is summoned to represent Love in a battle against Hate's champion, Atrocitus of the Red Lantern Corps.

episodes.title: Larfleeze
episodes.summary: The crew of The Interceptor searches the planet Okaara for the mythical Orange Lantern battery as a way to combat the Aya Monitor. The problem is, it's guarded under the watchful, and very greedy, eyes of Larfleeze, the one and only Orange Lantern.

episodes.title: Scarred
episodes.summary: Back on Oa, the crew of The Interceptor follow a series of clues which span across the galaxy, uncovering information about the mysterious "Science Director", Aya's secret origin, and how to put a stop to her destruction.

episodes.title: Ranx
episodes.summary: The Aya Monitor is after a secret weapon on the deserted planet Ranx, and sends a massive army of Manhunters to retrieve it.  While Hal, Kilowog and Razer are ordered to the planet, the Green Lantern Corps, led by Guy Gardner, launch a simultaneous attack to beat her to it.

episodes.title: Dark Matter
episodes.summary: In their last adventure, the Aya Monitor returns to the dawn of time to stop all emotion and all life from ever existing. Now, Hal, Kilowog, Gardner, and the Rest of the Green Lantern Corps must find a way to stop her – while Razer realizes the only way to save the universe may mean killing the woman he really loves.
